data.title: Anutin sets out five priorities for RTAF
data.description: <p>Prime Minister Anutin Charnvirakul has outlined five policy priorities to strengthen the Royal Thai Air Force's (RTAF) operational capabilities and national security.</p>

data.title: Khon Kaen temple land battle heats up
data.description: The abbot of a forest temple in Khon Kaen has produced the original title deed for land donated more than three decades ago, as the donor’s heirs intensify their efforts to reclaim the site.

data.title: Garage owner linked to MP’s shooting sentenced
data.description: NARATHIWAT - A court in this southern province has sentenced a garage owner to five years in prison for dismantling an Internal Security Operations Command (Isoc) pickup truck used in the shooting of a Prachachat Party MP.

data.title: French family rescued after night adrift off Samui
data.description: SURAT THANI: Three French tourists — a father and his two young sons — have been rescued after drifting overnight in the sea off Koh Samui when their rented jet ski became stranded in rough conditions.

data.title: Emirati tourists arrested after fleeing checkpoint, injuring policeman
data.description: PHUKET: Two Emirati tourists were arrested after allegedly fleeing a police checkpoint in Kathu district, kicking a pursuing officer’s motorcycle and causing him to crash during a chase, police said on Friday.

data.title: School in Loei suspends classes after student allegedly threatens shooting
data.description: Loei Pittayakom School in Loei province suspended on-site classes on Friday after discovering online chat messages in which a Matthayom Suksa 2 (Grade 8) student allegedly told a friend that he was planning to carry out a shooting at the school, reportedly inspired by the Aug 7 attack near Bangkok.

data.title: Department of Local Administration opens score review for local govt candidates
data.description: <p>Candidates in the 2025 local government recruitment examination can review their scores from now until the end of the month, acting Department of Local Administration (DLA) director-general Nirat Pongsitthaworn said yesterday.</p>

data.title: Thai schools step up security after deadly shooting
data.description: Students stood quietly outside their Bangkok school Friday as teachers checked their bags, pockets and even pencil cases under new security measures introduced after last week's deadly shooting.

data.title: Reservoir plan gets green light
data.description: <p>The Royal Irrigation Department will press ahead with the Khlong Wang Tanod reservoir in Chanthaburi, citing recent cabinet approval and the need for greater water security.</p>

data.title: Govt pledges to speed up distribution of village funds
data.description: <p>The government will accelerate the distribution of 3.4 billion baht from the National Village and Urban Community Fund to communities yet to receive additional capital.</p>

data.title: Teens arrested for assaulting and robbing Japanese tourist
data.description: Seven youths, between the ages of 13 and 17, were arrested on Thursday night for allegedly robbing and assaulting a Japanese tourist, who was lost near Makkasan Airport Rail Link station. The suspects told police they attacked the tourist with their fists to rob 1,400 baht.

data.title: QR case hearing on Aug 26
data.description: <p>The Constitutional Court has scheduled a witness hearing for Aug 26 in a case concerning the use of barcodes and QR codes on ballot papers in the Feb 8 general election.</p>

data.title: DLA opens score review for local govt candidates
data.description: <p>Candidates in the 2025 local government recruitment examination can review their scores from now until the end of the month, acting Department of Local Administration (DLA) director-general Nirat Pongsitthaworn said yesterday.</p>

data.title: Firms to design two new routes
data.description: <p>The State Railway of Thailand (SRT) board has approved consultancy contracts worth a combined 392.8 million baht to design two new railway projects linking the North and Northeast, with the contracts expected to be signed in September.</p>

data.title: Govt to host 29th ALMM
data.description: <p>Thailand will host the 29th Asean Labour Ministers Meeting (ALMM) from Aug 23-28 at the Dusit Thani Bangkok, focusing on internationally recognised skills certification to prepare the region's workforce for the digital and green economies and an ageing society.</p>

data.title: Dept warns of fake Lampang bowls
data.description: <p>The Department of Intellectual Property has warned consumers about widely sold fake Rooster-brand ceramic bowls native to Lampang in the northern region, citing the product's geographical indication (GI) protection.</p>

data.title: Chaichanok faces TH-AI subpoena
data.description: <p>The House budget monitoring committee may compel Digital Economy and Society Minister Chaichanok Chidchob to testify over the TH-AI Passport project after he failed to appear before the panel for a fourth time.</p>

data.title: House panel targets alleged Thai citizenship fraud
data.description: A House committee has urged authorities to dismantle a suspected transnational network that allegedly used Thai men as fake fathers to help children born to Chinese parents fraudulently obtain Thai citizenship.

data.title: Chaichana reports to police over 'assault'
data.description: Democrat Party deputy leader and Nakhon Si Thammarat MP Chaichana Detdecho reported to police on Thursday to acknowledge an assault charge and give a statement over an alleged physical confrontation with a senior police officer at a funeral.

data.title: US agrees to boost defence cooperation
data.description: <p>Thailand and the United States have reaffirmed their 193-year alliance, underscoring their commitment to strengthening modern security cooperation to address emerging security challenges.</p>

data.title: Japanese tourist injured in robbery near Bangkok Airport Rail Link station
data.description: A 43-year-old Japanese tourist was injured by a group of suspected robbers near Makkasan station on the Bangkok Airport Rail Link on Wednesday night, police said.

data.title: Household power bills to fall from Sept 1
data.description: Household electricity bills have been poised to fall from September after regulators approved a new tariff structure that removes public street-lighting costs from residential bills and caps the rate for the first 200 units of monthly consumption at no more than 3 baht per unit.
